findings.description: Idempotency check uses wrong property name 'exists' which doesn't exist in idempotencyService return value. The service returns 'locked', 'alreadyProcessed', 'inProgress' flags. This causes duplicate prevention to fail silently.
findings.suggestion: Change line ~85 from `if (idempotencyCheck.exists && idempotencyCheck.status === 'processing')` to `if (!idempotencyCheck.locked && idempotencyCheck.inProgress)`

findings.description: Mock endpoints (/api/tenant/pipo-systems, /api/tenant/test-connection, /api/pipo/systems/:systemId/discover) bypass the actual OData services and return simulated data. UI calls these instead of the real CAP services.
findings.suggestion: Either wire api-client.js to call the OData action endpoints (/api/tenant/savePipoSystem, /odata/v4/discovery/startDiscovery) or clearly mark mock endpoints as dev-only and add production routing

findings.description: Destination creation errors are silently swallowed in _createDestinationsAsync. Users see system status='configured' even when destinations failed to create.
findings.suggestion: Return destination creation status in savePipoSystem response, or set system status to 'destination_pending' to indicate async creation is incomplete

findings.description: Real discovery service's _emitProgress doesn't connect to server.js SSE broadcasting. Progress events from actual discoveries don't reach subscribed SSE clients.
findings.suggestion: Use CAP event mesh to publish progress events that server.js subscribes to, or expose a shared message broker

summary: Comprehensive CAP multitenant SaaS implementation with proper CDS schema design, cache/checkpoint/idempotency services, and UI wiring. One HIGH severity bug (idempotency property mismatch) needs fixing before merge. Mock endpoints create behavior divergence but are acceptable for development; should be documented or removed for production.
